references.text: The Lord said to Aaron that the Levites should have no inheritance in the land, for the Lord himself is their inheritance.
The Levites were not to have any inheritance among the children of Israel, but instead receive the tithes as their portion.
The tribe of Levi received no inheritance with their brothers; the Lord is their inheritance, just as the Lord promised them.
Levitical priests shall have no inheritance in Israel; the Lord is their inheritance.
Moses gave the Levites no inheritance in the land, but they were given cities to live in along with pasturelands for their livestock.
The Levites have no inheritance among you, for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance.
The priests shall have no inheritance; the Lord is their inheritance.
